product.name: Paper Trading India
product.real_money: No real-money trades, broker connection or orders

timeline.current_state: The 2026-11-16 forward checkpoint artifacts could not be recovered. The only verified portfolio state shown here is the 2026-11-13 historical-simulation terminal state; it is not today's live state. A continuation must be gap-labelled.

autonomy.scope: Virtual delivery paper trading only; no broker connection and no real orders.

stops.evaluation: Evaluate after each daily close; a breach creates a sell decision for the next trading day's open.
stops.limit: A stop is not a guaranteed fill or hard floor; overnight gaps can cross it.

delivery.basis: Daily OHLCV data, a delivery cost model and no leverage are implemented.

learning_loop.record: Log every decision and stop before execution, including no-trade days and skipped signals.
learning_loop.review: Compare net return, drawdown, skips and risk against suitable benchmarks.
learning_loop.change_control: Modify a strategy only as a new pre-specified experiment version; never rewrite rules after seeing results.

strategy.name: SMA 20/60 crossover
strategy.signal: Buy when SMA20 crosses above SMA60; sell when SMA20 crosses below SMA60.
strategy.execution: Next trading day's open with 10 bps assumed slippage per side.
strategy.sizing: 25% of equity per position, maximum 4 positions, no pyramiding.

caveats: Historical simulation only; it does not predict future results.
The +11.15% strategy result and +27.8% NIFTY 50 price-index result use unmatched treatments; the gap is not measured alpha.
The decision CSV is a deterministic backfill, not a contemporaneous decision record.
Paper fills ignore liquidity, partial fills and real slippage beyond the configured assumption.
No real-money trading is taking place.
